_readme: Every file under /public/images, with real pixel sizes. Backgrounds/heroes are 1672×941 (desktop) and 941×1672 (mobile); serve them with sizes= so next/image never upsamples; on ≥1400px viewports at 2× they will be slightly soft, which is acceptable for low-key photography (regenerate at 2560 later if the client wants). Cut-outs are RGBA with alpha 253–254 on the car (effectively opaque) — no halo. Use -m files under 768px via <picture> or next/image with media queries; never crop a -d file for mobile.
